questions.question: I weigh 85 kg. How much cargo can I carry on the Ebb?
questions.answer:
You can carry at most **97.6 kg of cargo in total** with an 85 kg rider, based on the maximum total load including the bike itself. [1]  

However, the front box is limited to **80 kg**, so you can carry **up to 80 kg in the box**. [1]

questions.question: How should I keep the battery over the winter when I'm not riding?
questions.answer: For winter storage longer than one month, keep the battery at 50–70% charge in a dry place between 10 and 20 °C, and top it back up to that level every three months. [1] Never store it fully empty, because a cell that drops below its minimum voltage may never charge again and that damage is not covered by warranty. [1] If the bike is stored outside for more than a day, remove the battery and take it indoors. [4]
